title: macOS PTY and process lifecycle
constraints: Pure Rust crate with rustix-openpty/POSIX APIs; do not import Alacritty's tty or event-loop stack.
macOS implementation now; expose internal platform boundary without fake Linux/Windows implementations.
One bounded writer queue with explicit capacity and backpressure result; no unbounded std or async channel.
Reader output delivery is bounded and preserves byte order.
Resize requests coalesce and identical dimensions are ignored.
Child becomes session/process-group leader with controlling terminal; parent retains master only.
Every successful spawn is terminated and reaped on explicit shutdown; Drop provides bounded best-effort terminate/reap without panic.
No unsafe block without a local SAFETY comment naming every invariant.
No GUI launch. Candidate skips validation and commits once.
api: PtySize validates nonzero rows/cols and converts to winsize.
CommandBuilder supports executable/argv, cwd, deterministic environment overlay, TERM, COLORTERM, and shell discovery from explicit value then SHELL then passwd fallback.
PtySession::spawn(config) returns a session plus bounded ordered output receiver and exit notification receiver.
PtySession implements resize, nonblocking bounded write enqueue, blocking/bounded write with timeout or equivalent explicit backpressure, child identity, try_wait, and shutdown_and_reap(grace).
Shutdown is idempotent; closes queues/master, sends SIGHUP/SIGTERM to child process group, waits grace, escalates SIGKILL, and waitpid reaps exactly once.
Reader handles EOF/EIO as clean closure; writer handles short writes/EINTR/EAGAIN; exit thread/owner cannot race double waitpid.
Public errors preserve io::Error sources and distinguish queue full/closed/timeout.
tests: real /bin/zsh and /bin/bash command output and exit status
rapid resize ends at final dimensions and duplicate resize is ignored
blocked writer hits bounded backpressure without memory growth
explicit shutdown leaves no child process
Drop fallback leaves no child process
acceptance: No orphan child after test completion
No unbounded queue type in production PTY code
